scenes.caption: One list of everything the client can do, with the chord that would have run it. A row tagged with a task is designed and not built: running it says so instead of doing nothing.

scenes.caption: The titles are always drawn, so the commands are discoverable without a key list. A row prints the chord that would have run it from anywhere; a row that prints nothing is a command the focused pane owns.
